script_text: Aquarius, the board changed. Monday is worst: Venus in Virgo opposes Neptune in Pisces, inflating romance and debt. Wednesday is career day because Mars in Gemini sextiles Saturn in Aries in your 11th House, making networking productive. Midweek, the Moon enters Libra, shifting focus to your 9th House, strategy, travel, and perspective. Thursday-Friday favor private research, contracts, and repairs; Mercury-Uranus aids technology or confidential work. Weekend warns against mixing passion with loans, taxes, or shared investments. Tuesday is power day because the Virgo New Moon clarifies 8th House resources. Monday is worst because Venus-Neptune magnifies desire and overspending. Before romance or business, write the financial boundary down. Follow for daily updates.
